summary: Complete implementation plan for overhauling the phishing email detection system. Covers adding missing detection modules (homoglyph, punycode/IDN, attachment analysis, HTML obfuscation, form action analysis, image-only detection, domain mismatch in URLs, subdomain abuse, Return-Path mismatch, PhishTank/OpenPhish integration, IP reputation checks) to the backend, plus a complete UI redesign that moves away from the generic dark-glassmorphism look to a professional cybersecurity command-center aesthetic with a manual email analyzer, real-time threat visualization, and per-engine drill-down.
